nodes.label: Lowest Hanging Fruit Prompt (buyer segments)
nodes.rationale: Finds easiest-to-convert buyers via 6 lenses (current spenders, adjacent markets, frustrated users, researcher stage, comparison shoppers, plateau population), ranks segments by market size / buyer readiness / advantage, then answers a key-benefit questionnaire per avatar in the customers' own words - ranked by Eugene Schwartz sophistication level and market size.
